card.title: PS5 HDMI Encoder Failure Symptoms and Diode Measurements

claims.statement: HDMI encoder failure can cause multiple catastrophic symptoms including no picture, no power, blue light of death, or 2 seconds of death.
claims.quote: If the Encoder IC fails, you can get • No Picture • No Power • blue light of death • Also 2 seconds of death

procedure: Check HDMI port and nearby components, data lines, filters, and encoder IC.
Perform diode measurements on the HDMI port pins against ground.
card.caveats: HDMI pin readings can vary slightly depending on meter calibration and board revision.
